runtime: OpenJDK 25.0.5 (Temurin-25.0.5+8) linux/arm64, the project base image

no_api_findings.finding: The only Java SE audio file API is provider based. In the project image the installed AudioFileReader providers are AiffFileReader, AuFileReader, SoftMidiAudioFileReader, WaveFileReader, WaveFloatFileReader and WaveExtensibleFileReader; both calls threw UnsupportedAudioFileException ("File of unsupported format") on controls/mp3/tone-44k-mono.mp3. AudioSystem.getAudioFileTypes() lists wav, au and aif only.
The documented standard file types are WAVE, AU, AIFF, AIFF-C and SND; none is MPEG audio.

Across every module from `java --list-modules`, `java --describe-module` exports no package whose name contains mp3, mpeg or media; the only audio exports are javax.sound, javax.sound.midi(.spi) and javax.sound.sampled(.spi).
javafx.scene.media plays MP3 but is not part of Java SE or the Temurin JDK since JDK 11; it ships as separate OpenJFX artifacts and has no frame-level parse API. Not counted.

probe: In-image Java Sound probe listing AudioSystem.getAudioFileTypes(), ServiceLoader AudioFileReader providers, and calling getAudioFileFormat/getAudioInputStream on the primary control (run 2026-11-17, not committed as a project).
limit: Inventory covers one OpenJDK 25.0.5 runtime image. A Java Sound SPI on the classpath (for example com.googlecode.soundlibs:mp3spi) adds MP3 support, but it is third party and logged as a lead. Matches the negative finding in data/java/mp3_id3v2/standard.json.
